claim: Table C.1 row: the Unit 42 assessment is the threat report the Black Basta Ransomware flow cites, and supports its c3 class (stole data and impeded systems).
quote:
The attackers not only execute ransomware but also exfiltrate sensitive
data and threaten to release it publicly if the ransom demands are not met.
locator: PDF p. 2 (web page, unpaginated), 'Black Basta Overview'
issue: Adversarial read: the report is a threat assessment of a ransomware-as-a-service operation across affiliates, not one intrusion; the flow is malware-scoped (metadata_audit.csv scope 'malware'), so the report matches its scope. Both halves are stated: exfiltration here and encryption ('It encrypts users’ data', PDF p. 1). The flow cites this Unit 42 URL. Holds.
